title: Cartwise+ Membership Past-Due Status and Non-Payment Cancellation
content:
**Rule.** When a Cartwise+ Membership period fee is declined, the membership becomes past due and the fee is retried the plan's number of automatic retries, spaced the plan's retry interval apart. Order benefits keep applying during past due only where the plan's terms say benefits continue while past due. A capture during past due reinstates the membership for the period that was being billed; the period dates do not move. The membership may be canceled for non-payment only after the grace period counted from the date it became past due has fully run. A cancellation for non-payment carries the cancel reason "unpaid", and no refund is owed because no fee was captured for the unpaid period.

## The grace period clock

- **Start:** the past-due date shown on the membership record (the date the fee was first declined) is day 0.
- **Length:** the plan's grace period in calendar days.
- **Comparison:** cancellation for non-payment is allowed from the day after the past-due date plus the grace days — not earlier. The last grace day itself still allows reinstatement.

| Hypothetical case (grace period of 10 days, past due since 1 May) | Result |
|---|---|
| Today is 11 May (day 10, the last grace day) | not yet cancelable; reinstatement is still allowed |
| Today is 12 May (the day after 1 May plus 10 days) | cancellation for non-payment is allowed |

| Hypothetical case (grace period of 14 days, past due since 1 May) | Result |
|---|---|
| Today is 15 May (day 14) | not yet cancelable |
| Today is 16 May | cancellation for non-payment is allowed |

## Reinstatement

The reinstatement rule applies to a membership that is past due. When the outstanding fee is captured, the membership returns to active and the past-due date is cleared, for the same period that was being billed — the period start and renewal date stay where they were.

## Points of judgement

- **Is anything refunded when a past-due membership is canceled for non-payment?** No. No fee was captured for the unpaid period, so no refund is owed.
- **Which evidence decides whether the grace period has run?** The past-due date on the membership record and the plan's grace days.
- **Do benefits continue while past due?** Only on a plan whose terms say they do; the grace-period days and the benefits flag are read per plan from the plan's declined-fee schedule.
